RIENSANG-PROCURATION_HERMES.title: Procuration [Hermes]
RIENSANG-PROCURATION_HERMES.description: At [blue]9[/blue] stacks, gain a [gold]Special Card[/gold] and [gold]Grace of the Prescript[/gold]. Max stacks are limited by [gold]Unlock[/gold] state.
RIENSANG-PROCURATION_HERMES.smartDescrip:
At [blue]9[/blue] stacks, gain a [gold]Special Card[/gold] and [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Grace of the Prescript[/gold]. 
At below [gold]Unlock II[/gold], max stack is limited to 8. 
Cannot be gained on the same turn after being consumed.
RIENSANG-MARKOFTHE_PRESCRIPT_POWER.title: Mark of the Prescript
RIENSANG-MARKOFTHE_PRESCRIPT_POWER.descr: Marks random cards each turn. Marked cards grant [gold]Grace of the Prescript[/gold] and [gold]Procuration [Hermes][/gold]. Unplayed marks grant [gold]Karmic Consequences[/gold].
RIENSANG-MARKOFTHE_PRESCRIPT_POWER.smart:
Marks [blue]2[/blue] random cards each turn. Marked cards grant [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Grace of the Prescript[/gold] and [gold]Procuration [Hermes][/gold]. 
Gain [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Karmic Consequences[/gold] for each unplayed Marked card.
RIENSANG-GRACEOFTHE_PRESCRIPT_POWER.desc: Accumulate stacks to gain [gold]Strength[/gold] and progress through [gold]Unlock[/gold] states.
RIENSANG-GRACEOFTHE_PRESCRIPT_POWER.smar: Max 9 stacks. At [blue]9[/blue] stacks Gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]. At [blue]3/6/9[/blue] stacks, grant [gold]Unlock I/II/III[/gold].
RIENSANG-UNLOCK.title: Unlock
RIENSANG-UNLOCK.description:
At [gold]Unlock III[/gold], gain [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. 
Additionally, upon reaching 9 [gold]Procuration Hermes[/gold] for the first time this combat, gain [gold]Shin (心) - Fate[/gold] 
Combat End: [gold]Heal[/gold] HP and SP based on state.
RIENSANG-UNLOCK.smartDescription:
At [gold]Unlock III[/gold], [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. 
Additionally, upon reaching 9 [gold]Procuration Hermes[/gold] for the first time this combat, gain [gold]Shin (心) - Fate[/gold].
Combat End: [gold]Heal[/gold] [blue]{HealAmount:diff()}[/blue] HP and [blue]{SPHealAmount:diff()}[/blue] SP at Unlock I/II/III.
RIENSANG-THE_PRESCRIPTS_TARGET.title: The Prescript’s Target
RIENSANG-SHIN_FATE.title: Shin (心) - [Fate]
RIENSANG-SHIN_FATE.description: Gain [gold]Energy[/gold] each turn. Deal more damage and increase [gold]Poise[/gold] gains.
RIENSANG-SHIN_FATE.smartDescription: Gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold] every turn. Deal [blue]5%[/blue] more damage. Gain more [gold]Poise Potency[/gold] and [gold]Count[/gold] from cards.
RIENSANG-WOUNDCASING_MASK.title: Woundcasing Mask
RIENSANG-WOUNDCASING_MASK.description: Take less unblocked damage. Converts to [gold]Sizzling Wound[/gold] if [gold]Furioso[/gold] is used.
RIENSANG-WOUNDCASING_MASK.smartDescripti: Take [blue]5%[/blue] less unblocked damage. Converts to [gold]Sizzling Wound[/gold] at turn end if [gold]Furioso[/gold] was used this combat. Expires.
RIENSANG-SIZZLING_WOUND.title: Sizzling Wound
RIENSANG-SIZZLING_WOUND.description: Take less unblocked damage and deal more damage. Take damage at turn end.
RIENSANG-SIZZLING_WOUND.smartDescription: Take [blue]10%[/blue] less unblocked damage and deal [blue]5%[/blue] more damage. Take [blue]2[/blue] damage at turn end.
RIENSANG-INDULGENCE_IN_PRESCRIPT.title: Indulgence in Prescript
RIENSANG-INDULGENCE_IN_PRESCRIPT.smartDe: Apply the following to Furioso: Inflict 1 Sinking Potency and Gain 1 more Poise Potency. Deal 10% more damage. Expires at turn end.
RIENSANG-KARMIC_CONSEQUENCE.title: Karmic Consequence
RIENSANG-KARMIC_CONSEQUENCE.description: Gain [gold]Fragile[/gold] and [gold]Detriments[/gold] as stacks increase. [red]Dies[/red] at 100 stacks.
RIENSANG-KARMIC_CONSEQUENCE.smartDescrip:
Gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Fragile[/gold] for every [blue]20[/blue] stacks. 
[blue]At 40 stacks[/blue]: Gain a temporary [gold]Curse[/gold]. 
[blue]At 60 stacks[/blue]: [gold]Draw 1 less card each turn[/gold]. 
[blue]At 80 stacks[/blue]: Gain a permanent [gold]Curse[/gold]. 
[blue]At 100 stacks[/blue]: [red]Dies[/red].
RIENSANG-STAR_OF_THE_CITY_POWER.title: Star of the City
RIENSANG-STAR_OF_THE_CITY_POWER.descript: On turn start, inflict [gold]Sinking Potency[/gold] and [gold]Count[/gold] on ALL enemies.
RIENSANG-STAR_OF_THE_CITY_POWER.smartDes: On turn start, Inflict [blue]{SinkingPotency}[/blue] [gold]Sinking Potency[/gold] and [blue]{SinkingCount}[/blue] [gold]Count[/gold] on ALL enemies.
RIENSANG-THE_INDEX_NURSEFATHER_POWER.des: Inflict [gold]Weak[/gold] at start of turn. At [gold]Unlock III[/gold], draw an extra card.
RIENSANG-THE_INDEX_NURSEFATHER_POWER.sma: Inflict [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] to a random enemy at the start of each turn. At [gold]Unlock III[/gold], [gold]Draw[/gold] 1 card each turn.
RIENSANG-GRACE_OF_GOD_POWER.title: Grace of God
RIENSANG-GRACE_OF_GOD_POWER.description: Prevents lethal damage for one turn. Expires after activation.
RIENSANG-GRACE_OF_GOD_POWER.smartDescrip: If this unit would take lethal damage this combat, becomes immune to damage for the turn. Expires.
RIENSANG-SHATTERED_WORLD.title: Shattered World
RIENSANG-SHATTERED_WORLD.description: Takes more damage from [gold]Burn[/gold] and [gold]Yi Sang[/gold].
RIENSANG-SHATTERED_WORLD.smartDescriptio: Takes [blue]1.2x[/blue] more damage from [gold]Burn[/gold]. Takes [blue]10%[/blue] more damage from [gold]Yi Sang[/gold].
RIENSANG-PAINFUL_SCAR.title: Painful Scar
RIENSANG-PAINFUL_SCAR.description: Panic Status. Gain [gold]Burn[/gold] and [gold]Bleed[/gold] each turn and take more damage. Removed at [blue]0[/blue] [gold]SP[/gold].
RIENSANG-PAINFUL_SCAR.smartDescription: Panic Status. Each turn, Gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Burn Potency[/gold], [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Burn Count[/gold]. Gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Bleed Potency[/gold] and [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Bleed Count[/gold]. Take [blue]10%[/blue] more damage. Removed at 0 [gold]SP[/gold].
RIENSANG-THE_ORACLES_PROXY_POWER.title: The Oracle's Proxy
RIENSANG-THE_ORACLES_PROXY_POWER.descrip: [gold]Hermes[/gold] plays for you and heals your HP each turn.
RIENSANG-THE_ORACLES_PROXY_POWER.smartDe: [gold]Hermes[/gold] plays for you. Remaining turns: [blue]{Amount}[/blue]. Heal [blue]{HealAmount:diff()}[/blue] [gold]HP[/gold] each turn.
RIENSANG-ORACLE_DEVICE_POWER.title: Oracle Device [Caduceus]
RIENSANG-EQUIVALENT_EXCHANGE_POWER.title: Equivalent Exchange
RIENSANG-EQUIVALENT_EXCHANGE_POWER.descr: Damage received is converted to [gold]Karma[/gold] instead.
RIENSANG-EQUIVALENT_EXCHANGE_POWER.smart: Damage received this turn is converted to [gold]Karma[/gold] instead.
RIENSANG-DEFENSIVE_STANCE_POWER.title: Defensive Stance
RIENSANG-DEFENSIVE_STANCE_POWER.descript: Attack cards gain [gold]Block[/gold] instead of dealing damage.
RIENSANG-DEFENSIVE_STANCE_POWER.smartDes: Attack cards you played this turn will gain [gold]Block[/gold] instead of dealing damage.
RIENSANG-FAITH_BEYOND_QUESTION_POWER.des: Increase damage of ALL Blind Faith each time it is used.
RIENSANG-FAITH_BEYOND_QUESTION_POWER.sma: Blind Faith cards currently deal [blue]{Potency}[/blue] bonus damage. Each further Blind Faith played will increase this bonus by [blue]{Amount}[/blue].
RIENSANG-POISED_WARDING_POWER.title: Poised Warding
RIENSANG-POISED_WARDING_POWER.descriptio: Gain [gold]Poise Potency[/gold] each turn. On [gold]Crit[/gold]: Gain [gold]Block[/gold].
RIENSANG-POISED_WARDING_POWER.smartDescr:
At the start of each turn, Gain [blue]{PoiseGain}[/blue] [gold]Poise Potency[/gold].
[gold]On Crit[/gold]: Gain [blue]{BlockGain}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
RIENSANG-SORS_SALUTIS_POWER.title: Sors Salutis
RIENSANG-SORS_SALUTIS_POWER.description: If you would take more than [blue]10[/blue] damage, take half of it as damage and the other half as [gold]Karmic Consequence[/gold].
RIENSANG-SORS_SALUTIS_POWER.smartDescrip: If you would take more than [blue]10[/blue] damage, take half of it as damage and the other half as [gold]Karmic Consequence[/gold].
RIENSANG-SORS_IMMANIS_POWER.title: Sors Immanis
RIENSANG-SORS_IMMANIS_POWER.description: Take an extra turn. Costs [gold]Karmic Consequence[/gold].
RIENSANG-DIVINE_PROTECTION_POWER.title: Divine Protection
RIENSANG-KARMIC_CONSEQUENCE_FORTUNA.desc: Gain [gold]Fragile[/gold] and [gold]Detriments[/gold] as stacks increase. [red]Dies[/red] at 200 stacks.
RIENSANG-KARMIC_CONSEQUENCE_FORTUNA.smar:
Gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Fragile[/gold] for every [blue]20[/blue] stacks. 
[blue]At 40 stacks[/blue]: Gain a temporary [gold]Curse[/gold]. 
[blue]At 80 stacks[/blue]: Gain [blue]2[/blue] temporary [gold]Curses[/gold] and [gold]Draw 1 less card each turn[/gold]. 
[blue]At 100 stacks[/blue]: [gold]-1 Energy each turn[/gold]. 
[blue]At 120 stacks[/blue]: Gain a permanent [gold]Curse[/gold]. 
[blue]At 160 stacks[/blue]: Gain another permanent [gold]Curse[/gold] and [gold]Draw 1 less cards[/gold]. 
[blue]At 200 stacks[/blue]: [red]Dies[/red].
RIENSANG-ATONEMENT_POWER.title: Atonement
RIENSANG-ATONEMENT_POWER.description: Each [gold]Marked[/gold] card played will now reduce [gold]Karmic Consequence[/gold].
RIENSANG-ATONEMENT_POWER.smartDescriptio: Reduces [gold]Karmic Consequence[/gold] by [blue]{KarmaReduction}[/blue] whenever you play a [gold]Marked[/gold] card.
